identity: Native Windows startup PowerShell downloader attached to a game-bridge test executable
analysis_method: Static PE facts and Rizin disassembly; no sample execution
evidence: PE entry at 0x402798 enters CRT startup. At 0x402683 the initializer interval 0x41d160..0x41d16c is passed to 0x40b3d3; the nonzero callback at 0x41d168 is 0x401000.

Initializer 0x401000 copies the command at 0x41d200 and passes it at 0x401085 to 0x405d0b, a thunk into CRT system() at 0x405bf0. The routine obtains COMSPEC, constructs /c arguments and calls the spawn implementation.
The command minimizes cmd.exe, invokes hidden PowerShell, downloads from an HTTPS PHP URL into $env:TEMP\BK461320.exe and starts that same executable with WindowStyle Hidden.

main at 0x402020 performs expiry, endpoint-syntax, capability-length and numeric-range tests of RcSeasonBind and the --RCSEASON1 context parser. It writes JSON context into an anonymous pipe and writes a pass/fail report.
The raw-IP URL is a bridge-test input. No static evidence ties it to the payload fetch, repeated check-in, received tasking, theft, ransomware or the filename family labels.
IsDebuggerPresent, VirtualProtect, PE magic checks, mscoree.dll and API-set strings occur in CRT/runtime support; their emitted traits describe references or neutral capabilities.
repairs: Removed unsupported native raw-IP C2 composite.
Moved the neutral direct-IP URL grouping into micro-behaviors/communications/http/url/external-ip and updated every named consumer without changing matching scope.
Replaced unlinked native staging composite with exact-path-bound payload execution and nested hidden-launch composites.
Described decoded Base64-compatible bytes as compatibility evidence, rather than claiming intentional encoding of the repeated-character test capability.
coverage_limit: Two hostile results describe the demonstrated payload chain and its concealment. A third independent hostile behavior is not established, so no family or C2 conviction was invented to reach a count.

verification.focused_controls: 8/8 passed: renamed destination, full cmdlet, case variation, mismatched filename, mismatched environment path, visible updater and bare URL
